Initial release of 4K Editing with OpenShot — cloud-based 4K video editing for creators.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or MKV videos (up to 500MB) and get 4K edited videos in minutes.
- AI handles cutting, transitions, and exporting in 4K, simulating an OpenShot workflow.
- No software installation needed; all processing happens on cloud GPUs.
- Simple setup: automatic connection with anonymous token for 100 free credits.
- Supports timeline preview, exporting, credits check, and iterative editing in-session.
- Batch process multiple files or refine edits over several steps.
